title: Initial parity tree assignment
statement: Let $n,r,g$ be natural numbers and let $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$. The parity tree assignment at level zero and group index $g$ equals the assignment whose $j$th coordinate is the $g r+j$th coordinate of $x$ when $g r+j<n$, and is $1$ otherwise, for each $j\in\{0,\ldots,r-1\}$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a point of the $n$-dimensional sign cube
